svg.aria-label: Constructed 0.5 μL, 70° cap with 2 μm coordinate noise. A compares true and 20 μm-raised baselines; B shows radial residuals; C changes the baseline of one fitted circle; D repeats 300 independent noise simulations. Repeat precision and shared baseline bias are separated.
